name: Husqvarna 530iPT5
blurb: 10″ pole-saw bar on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The 530iPT5 is listed in Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) as a battery pole saw. The guide gives one combination: a 10″ bar, 3/8″ mini (low profile), .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, file 5/32″, chain H37 591106040, bar Laminate 596298540.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 10″ setup with bar Laminate 596298540 and chain H37 591106040. Pitch in the guide is 3/8 Mini. File size 5/32″. The guide's type column is Pole Saw - Battery.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027): certified/approved bar and chain combinations, with bar length, pitch, gauge, drive links, file size, bar part and chain part

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover dated 2027, PDF read 9 Nov 2026 (https://media.husqvarnagroup.com/original/DI-328359.pdf). Every row restates that saw's entry in the guide.
